q: 01.How do I set up my Payway account?Sign up in minutes and follow the simple onboarding steps to start accepting paymen
expanded: 01.How do I set up my Payway account?
02.Can I update my account details?Yes, you can update your business profile, bank information, and contact details anytime through the merchant dashboard settings.

q: 03.What should I do if I forget my password?
expanded: 03.What should I do if I forget my password?Simply click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. We'll send a secure reset link to your registered email address immediately.
04.How fast are payments processed?Payway processes domestic transactions in real-time. Settlements usually arrive in your linked bank account within 24 hours depending on the provider.
05.Can I accept international payments?Absolutely! Payway supports over 100+ global currencies and automated mid-market rate conversions for seamless cross-border trade.
06.Is there a limit on transactions?Standard accounts have flexible limits based on verification levels. High-volume businesses can request custom limit increases via support.
